text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: *cough*! *cough* *hack*!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Aww man, everyone else is having lunch break right now...
Why am I the only one stuck... *cough*!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...This is so boring.
(Rattle!)

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yo, Teio!!
Let's play Squid Catch!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Golshi?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
The window was unlocked—which means
you're expressing your intention to join Squid Catch
...right?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha, what kind of game is that?!
I've never even heard of it! ...*cough*.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Well, I was bored anyway.
If Golshi wants to play, I guess I could keep you com—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You most certainly may not!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Phew... I can't let my guard down for a single moment.
Teio-san, please return to bed at once.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Wha... I-I'm fine, McQueen!
I'm already totally healthy! ...*cough*.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
If it's the time everyone else gets to play,
I should be allowed to play too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Ah, wait—

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
! Teio-san!!
Are you feeling better already?!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Huh, Spe-chan?
And—

text_block_list.name: Silence Suzuka
text_block_list.text:
Um... we brought some refreshments.
Spe-chan and I discussed it, and got
honey porridge from the Hachimii shop...

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Me too! I brought some green onions straight from my mom!
She swears wrapping them around your neck cures you in no time!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Vodka!
Suzuka-san was just talking, wasn't she?!

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text:
Teio, I brought some fruit for you.
Vitamin C is super important when you've caught a cold.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
E-Everyone...
Did you all come by to visit me...?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Ehehe, we have plenty of free time during lunch break, after all!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, exactly. Scarlet was whining non-stop about being so worried.
So I ended up tagging along too...

text_block_list.name: Daiwa Scarlet
text_block_list.text: "Tagging along"?! You were the one fidgeting around nervously the entire time during class, weren't you?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Well, long story short, both Scarlet and Vodka just really wanted to see ya.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Far from simply stealing a march, some people went so far as to intrude without permission, desu wa.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
I see, I see!
Aw, geez... hehe!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
McQueen, I'm heading back to my room after all!
I've gotta get plenty of rest today!!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Thanks everyone, too♪
I'll take all the get-well gifts back with me!
I've gotta make sure I recover and get full of energy!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: ...Hehehe. Geez, you guys just love me so much, don't you~?

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Hehe—guess I have no choice.
For everyone's sake, I'd better sleep early and get all energized for you!
And so today, the horse girls pass through the school gates once again, heading to class full of energy.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Mooornin'♪
Spe-chan! And McQueen too!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Ehehe... thank you so much!!
